title: The fix check on a guard or check PR runs on sonnet
why: A stronger read on the riskiest fixes.
note:
Owner question: item 351 (Sonnet or Haiku for guard fix checks), 13:30 CST Nov 7.
Owner on item 279, 12:43 CST: c is not an agent that argues back, so it is out of that set; a separate question if wanted. Debate audit 12:40 CST. Main runs haiku for the round-1 fix check. Lane counted 351 a at 14:44:58 CST. Build: a fix-check brief marker the spawn guard reads (one constant in hooks/shared_names.py), since ROLE_REVIEWER_FREE_ROUNDS refuses a reviewer above Haiku with no round marker; agents/reviewer.md line 73 and the agent-model-cap row; a merge-tool refusal of a Haiku fix check on a `Guard or check: yes` record. Guard change, full review rounds. Pattern (coordinator 14:25 CST Nov 8): lanes run fix checks on Haiku while reviewers run Sonnet from round 2 on (#2257, #2196 today). Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m, 14:41 CST Nov 8; folded here instead of a new step fix-check-model-floor): the lane ran fix checks on Haiku for #1458 and #1774 after records whose last round ran on Sonnet; runner 8 held #1458 at 14:31 CST. Proposed guard: merge.review_body and parse_review refuse a Fix check line whose model is below the model of the record's last round, so merge --reviewed cannot accept it. No owner wait remains (triage read 14:45 CST Nov 8): item 279 is closed, and item 351 was answered a on Nov 7 14:44 CST. The wider form (Sonnet fix checks on every PR) waits on owner item 444 (fix-check-model-all-prs); the coordinator withdrew its 14:42 pick as a variant of 351 a. Named bandaid allowed meanwhile: brief line 1 "Round 3 of 3", line 2 says it is a fix check. Owner item 444 a (15:04 CST Nov 8): every fix check runs on Sonnet, on every PR. Sent to the lane 15:05 CST. Sighting (coordinator 17:17 CST Nov 8): lane merge-ready-uses-pin (#2303) had Sonnet refused for its test-author, its round 1 and its fix checks, so it fell back to Haiku. That breaks owner 444 a, and #2303 now needs a fresh chain. Scope to add: the refusal names the accepted form (a reviewer brief whose first line is `Round 2 of 3`, `Round 3 of 3`, or `Round N of 3 (fix check)`) and says that round 1 and the test-author run on their role's model. The refusal-wording scope moves to step model-refusal-names-forms, after #2342 (coordinator 17:21 CST, the lane's pick 2). PR: #2342 (guard-fix-check-marker-2, head 6b99c70df) replaces #2296 and is the home of owner item 444 a (coordinator 17:58 CST Nov 8).
